in_sanskrit.name: Atabul
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Fire
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Atabul एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Atabula is an alternate name for the god Agni, who is the deity of fire and is regarded as the god of agriculture, sacrifices, and the purifier. He is also believed to be the conduit between the gods and humanity.
